message.Title: Public Preview: Azure Databricks workspace-wide Genie MCP for Microsoft Copilot Studio

Body.Content:
A new workspace-wide Genie MCP endpoint enables any Microsoft Copilot Studio agent to query natural-language questions across an entire Azure Databricks workspace through a single endpoint. The endpoint auto-routes across all connected Genie spaces and Unity Catalog data, replacing the previous per-space configuration requirement and reducing integration overhead significantly. Business users get governed, workspace-wide data access directly inside Microsoft Teams and M365 Copilot.

Learn more.
